```{r}
# Safe z-score function (NA-aware; if sd==0, return 0 for non-NA rows)
z_by_site <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(s) || s == 0) {
    return(ifelse(is.na(x), NA_real_, 0))
  } else {
    return((x - m) / s)
  }
}

# Static predictors to keep for all models

static_predictors <- c(
  "Air_trange", "WL_daily_range",
  "GWT_range", "GWL_range", "Water_area_m2_3d",
  "Elev_m", "Size_km2"

# Revised: select one temporal representation per group using univariate GAMs.
# The function accepts a training dataset so it can later be called INSIDE
# each outer CV training fold in Wetland_global_models.
# The five folds below are INNER, week-blocked folds for GAM comparison.

make_gam_weekly_folds <- function(data, k = 5, seed = 42) {
  weeks <- unique(lubridate::floor_date(as.Date(data$Datetime),
                                        unit = "week", week_start = 1))
  if (length(weeks) < k) stop("Not enough distinct weeks for GAM cross-validation")
  set.seed(seed)
  weeks <- sample(weeks)
  groups <- split(weeks, rep(seq_len(k), length.out = length(weeks)))
  lapply(groups, function(w) {
    which(lubridate::floor_date(as.Date(data$Datetime),
                               unit = "week", week_start = 1) %in% w)
  })
}

select_gam_predictors <- function(train_data, response_var, k_folds = 5, seed = 42) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(predictor_groups, function(vars, group_name) {
    existing <- intersect(vars, names(train_data))
    if (!length(existing)) return(tibble())

    # Compare alternatives on exactly the same observations within each group.
    common <- train_data %>%
      select(all_of(c("Datetime", response_var, existing))) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na()
    if (!nrow(common)) stop("No complete data for group: ", group_name)
    folds <- make_gam_weekly_folds(common, k = k_folds, seed = seed)

    scores <- purrr::map_dfr(existing, function(v) {
      pred <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(common))
      for (holdout in folds) {
        training <- common[-holdout, , drop = FALSE]
        # Use the same smooth complexity for each candidate; k=5 basis dimension.
        # Fall back to a linear term when insufficient unique training values.
        smooth_ok <- length(unique(training[[v]])) >= 5
        f <- if (smooth_ok) {
          stats::as.formula(paste0(response_var, " ~ s(`", v, "`, k = 5)"))
        } else {
          stats::reformulate(v, response = response_var)
        }
        fit <- mgcv::gam(f, data = training, method = "REML")
        pred[holdout] <- stats::predict(fit, newdata = common[holdout, , drop = FALSE])
      }
      tibble(predictor = v, cv_rmse = sqrt(mean((common[[response_var]] - pred)^2)))
    })
    scores %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cv_rmse, match(predictor, existing)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = group_name, n = nrow(common), .before = 1)
  })
}


# Training-site means/SDs are used for both train and withheld rows.
standardize_fold <- function(train, test = NULL) {
  cols <- intersect(vars_to_scale, names(train))
  stats <- train %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Site) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(cols),
      list(
        mu = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sigma = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  apply_stats <- function(d) {
    d <- left_join(d, stats, by="Site")
    for (v in cols) {
      mu <- d[[paste0(v,"_mu")]]
      sig <- d[[paste0(v,"_sigma")]]
      d[[v]] <- ifelse(is.na(d[[v]]), NA_real_,
                        ifelse(is.na(sig) | sig == 0, 0, (d[[v]]-mu)/sig))
    }
    d %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of(unlist(lapply(cols, function(v) c(paste0(v,"_mu"),paste0(v,"_sigma"))))))
  }
  list(train = apply_stats(train), test = if (is.null(test)) NULL else apply_stats(test))
}

select_for_set <- function(train_df, response, mode, k = 5) {

  # Restrict candidate predictors before GAM screening
  eligible <- get_predictors(train_df, response, mode = mode)

  gam <- select_gam_predictors(
    train_data = train_df[, unique(c("Datetime", response, eligible)),
                          drop = FALSE],
    response_var = response,
    k_folds = k
  )

  # Add eligible static predictors
  static <- intersect(static_predictors, eligible)

  selected <- unique(c(gam$predictor, static))

  list(
    predictors = selected,
    selection = gam
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Remove any columns that start with these prefixes
remote_exclude_prefix <- c("WL_", "GWT_", "GWL_", "Water")

# Build predictor vector for a given df + mode
get_predictors <- function(df, response_col, mode = c("all", "remote")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  base <- setdiff(names(df), c(response_col, "Site", "Datetime")) # never model on ID/time
  if (mode == "all") return(base)
  # Remote-only: drop exact matches + prefixed columns if present
  drop_prefixed <- unlist(lapply(remote_exclude_prefix, function(p) grep(paste0("^", p), base, value = TRUE)))
  setdiff(base, unique(c(remote_exclude_exact, drop_prefixed)))
}
```


**CV: Build blocked folds by week**
*Keeps whole weeks together (reduces inflated accuracy from adjacent days)*
```{r}
make_weekly_folds <- function(df, k = 5, date_col = "Datetime") {
  df <- df %>% mutate(.week = floor_date(.data[[date_col]], unit = "week", week_start = 1))
  weeks <- unique(df$.week)
  set.seed(42)
  weeks <- sample(weeks)        # shuffle weeks
  folds <- split(weeks, cut(seq_along(weeks), breaks = k, labels = FALSE))

  index <- list(); indexOut <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    val_weeks <- folds[[i]]
    val_idx <- which(df$.week %in% val_weeks)
    trn_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df)), val_idx)
    index[[paste0("Fold", i)]]    <- trn_idx
    indexOut[[paste0("Fold", i)]] <- val_idx
  }
  list(index = index, indexOut = indexOut)
}
```

**Metrics**
```{r}
nse <- function(obs, pred) {
  1 - sum((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum((obs - mean(obs, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Compute overall + by-site metrics from out-of-fold predictions
compute_metrics <- function(pred_df, truth_col = "obs", pred_col = "pred", site_col = "Site") {
  # Overall
  overall <- tibble(
    RMSE = RMSE(pred_df[[pred_col]], pred_df[[truth_col]]),
    MAE  = MAE (pred_df[[pred_col]], pred_df[[truth_col]]),
    R2   = R2  (pred_df[[pred_col]], pred_df[[truth_col]]),
    NSE  = nse (pred_df[[truth_col]], pred_df[[pred_col]])
  )

  # By-site
  by_site <- pred_df %>%
    group_by(.data[[site_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      RMSE = RMSE(.data[[pred_col]], .data[[truth_col]]),
      MAE  = MAE (.data[[pred_col]], .data[[truth_col]]),
      R2   = R2  (.data[[pred_col]], .data[[truth_col]]),
      NSE  = nse (.data[[truth_col]], .data[[pred_col]]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(Site = .data[[site_col]])

  list(overall = overall, by_site = by_site)
}
```

**Hyperparameter grids (Stage 2: refined; unchanged)**
```{r}
rf_grid_refined <- function(p) {
  expand.grid(
    mtry          = sort(unique(pmax(1, c(
                        floor(sqrt(p))-1, floor(sqrt(p)), floor(sqrt(p))+1,
                        floor(p/4), floor(p/3), floor(p/2), ceiling(2*p/3)
                      )))),
    splitrule     = "variance",
    min.node.size = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 15),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

xgb_grid_refined <- expand.grid(
  nrounds          = c(400, 800),
  eta              = c(0.05, 0.1),
  max_depth        = c(6, 9, 12),
  min_child_weight = c(1, 4),
  subsample        = c(0.8, 0.9),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.8, 1.0),
  gamma            = c(0, 0.1, 1.0)
)
```

**Core model trainer (XGB or RFR) with blocked CV + saved OOF predictions**
```{r}
train_model <- function(data, response, predictors = NULL,
                        model_type = c("xgb", "rfr"), k = 5,
                        site_col = "Site", date_col = "Datetime", tune_grid = NULL,
                        mode = "all") {
  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)
  df <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[response]]))
  folds <- make_weekly_folds(df, k = k, date_col = date_col)
  oof_list <- vector("list", k)
  fold_selection <- vector("list", k)

  # The outer folds are never used for GAM selection or tuning.
  # For minimal changes, GAM selection is performed once per OUTER training
  # partition, before caret's INNER hyperparameter CV. Thus outer performance
  # is unbiased by screening, though inner tuning does not repeat GAM screening.
  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    tr <- df[folds$index[[i]], , drop = FALSE]
    va <- df[folds$indexOut[[i]], , drop = FALSE]
    scaled <- standardize_fold(tr, va)
    tr <- scaled$train; va <- scaled$test
    chosen <- select_for_set(tr, response, mode, k = 5)
    preds <- chosen$predictors
    fold_selection[[i]] <- chosen$selection %>% mutate(fold = i, .before = 1)
    tr_fit <- tr %>% select(all_of(c(response, preds))) %>% drop_na()
    va_fit <- va %>% select(all_of(c("Site", "Datetime", response, preds))) %>% drop_na()

    # Existing tuning grids and caret models are retained. Inner weekly folds
    # tune hyperparameters within the outer-training observations only.
    inner <- make_weekly_folds(tr[complete.cases(tr[,c(response,preds)]),,drop=FALSE], k=5)
    ctrl <- trainControl(method="cv", number=5, index=inner$index,
                         indexOut=inner$indexOut, savePredictions="final",
                         allowParallel=TRUE)
    grid <- if (!is.null(tune_grid)) tune_grid else
      if (model_type == "rfr") rf_grid_refined(length(preds)) else xgb_grid_refined
    form <- reformulate(preds, response=response)
    fit <- if (model_type == "rfr") {
      caret::train(form, data=tr_fit, method="ranger", trControl=ctrl,
                   tuneGrid=grid, metric="RMSE", importance="permutation",
                   num.trees=500, num.threads=1)
    } else {
      caret::train(form, data=tr_fit, method="xgbTree", trControl=ctrl,
                   tuneGrid=grid, metric="RMSE", nthread=1)
    }
    oof_list[[i]] <- tibble(Site=va_fit$Site, Date=va_fit$Datetime, fold=i,
                            obs=va_fit[[response]], pred=as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata=va_fit)))
  }
  oof <- bind_rows(oof_list)
  mets <- compute_metrics(oof)

  # Final full-data model: GAM selection and tuning for interpretation.
  full <- standardize_fold(df)$train
  chosen_full <- select_for_set(full, response, mode, k=5)
  preds_full <- chosen_full$predictors
  full_fit <- full %>% select(all_of(c(response, preds_full))) %>% drop_na()
  full_folds <- make_weekly_folds(full[complete.cases(full[,c(response,preds_full)]),,drop=FALSE], k=5)
  full_ctrl <- trainControl(method="cv", number=5, index=full_folds$index,
                            indexOut=full_folds$indexOut, savePredictions="final", allowParallel=TRUE)
  full_grid <- if (!is.null(tune_grid)) tune_grid else
    if (model_type == "rfr") rf_grid_refined(length(preds_full)) else xgb_grid_refined
  fit_full <- if (model_type == "rfr") {
    caret::train(reformulate(preds_full, response), data=full_fit,
                 method="ranger", trControl=full_ctrl, tuneGrid=full_grid,
                 metric="RMSE", importance="permutation", num.trees=500, num.threads=1)
  } else {
    caret::train(reformulate(preds_full, response), data=full_fit,
                 method="xgbTree", trControl=full_ctrl, tuneGrid=full_grid,
                 metric="RMSE", nthread=1)
  }
  vimp <- varImp(fit_full)$importance %>% rownames_to_column("Variable") %>% arrange(desc(Overall))
  list(response=response, model_type=model_type, predictors=preds_full,
       best_params=fit_full$bestTune, cv_results=fit_full$results,
       metrics_overall=mets$overall, metrics_by_site=mets$by_site,
       var_importance=vimp, oof_predictions=oof,
       fold_selection=bind_rows(fold_selection),
       selection_full=chosen_full$selection, fit_object=fit_full)
}
```

**Build datasets for each predictor set**
*- Set A (All): exclude Hideaway & Cooper*
*- Set B (Remote-only): include all 7 sites; drop WL/GWT/GWL vars*
```{r}
sites_exclude_all <- c("Hideaway","Cooper")

prep_dataset <- function(df, response_key, mode = c("all","remote")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  response_col <- resp_cols[[response_key]]

  df2 <- df
  if (mode == "all") {
    df2 <- df2 %>% filter(!(Site %in% sites_exclude_all))
  }
  preds <- get_predictors(df2, response_col, mode = mode)
  list(data = df2, response = response_col, predictors = preds)
}
```

**Run global models for all responses and both predictor sets**
*(XGB and RFR; 5-fold blocked CV)*
```{r}
run_all <- function() {
  results <- list()

  for (resp_key in c("max","mean","range")) {
    # Select the right data frame for this response
    df <- switch(resp_key,
                 max   = max_df,
                 mean  = mean_df,
                 range = range_df)

    # Set A: All predictors (5 sites)
    A <- prep_dataset(df, resp_key, mode = "all")
    # XGB
    results[[paste(resp_key,"A_xgb",sep="_")]] <- train_model(
      data = A$data, response = A$response, predictors = A$predictors,
      model_type = "xgb", k = 5, mode = "all"
    )
    # RFR
    results[[paste(resp_key,"A_rfr",sep="_")]] <- train_model(
      data = A$data, response = A$response, predictors = A$predictors,
      model_type = "rfr", k = 5, mode = "all"
    )

    # Set B: Remote-only (7 sites)
    B <- prep_dataset(df, resp_key, mode = "remote")
    # XGB
    results[[paste(resp_key,"B_xgb",sep="_")]] <- train_model(
      data = B$data, response = B$response, predictors = B$predictors,
      model_type = "xgb", k = 5, mode = "remote"
    )
    # RFR
    results[[paste(resp_key,"B_rfr",sep="_")]] <- train_model(
      data = B$data, response = B$response, predictors = B$predictors,
      model_type = "rfr", k = 5, mode = "remote"
    )
  }

  results
}
```

**Global lme models**

*setting up VIF function, AR(1) correlation structure*
```{r}
library(nlme)
library(car)        
library(performance)
library(broom)

# Iteratively drop the highest-VIF predictor until all VIF <= thresh
vif_prune <- function(train_df, response, preds, thresh = 5) {
  keep <- preds
  dropped <- character(0)

  # Guard: remove constant or all-NA predictors first
  nzv <- keep[sapply(keep, function(v) sd(train_df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)]
  if (length(nzv)) {
    keep <- setdiff(keep, nzv)
    dropped <- c(dropped, nzv)
  }

  repeat {
    if (length(keep) <= 1L) break

    fm <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", paste(keep, collapse = "+")))
    fit_lm <- try(lm(fm, data = train_df), silent = TRUE)

    if (inherits(fit_lm, "try-error")) break

    # Check for aliased coefficients
    aliased <- names(coef(fit_lm))[is.na(coef(fit_lm))]
    if (length(aliased) > 0) {
      keep <- setdiff(keep, aliased)
      dropped <- c(dropped, aliased)
      next
    }

    # Safely compute VIFs
    v <- try(suppressWarnings(car::vif(fit_lm)), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(v, "try-error") || any(!is.finite(v))) break

    vmax <- max(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (vmax <= thresh) break

    drop_this <- names(v)[which.max(v)]
    keep <- setdiff(keep, drop_this)
    dropped <- c(dropped, drop_this)
  }

  list(keep = keep, dropped = dropped)
}


# Build AR(1) correlation structure on a Date column
make_cor_ar1 <- function(df, date_col = "Datetime", site_col = "Site") {
  # nlme wants a numeric time; use days since origin
  corAR1(form = as.formula(paste0("~ as.numeric(", date_col, ") | ", site_col)))
}
```

*extra functions for running LME and evaluating VIF*
```{r}
#  helper to fit lme safely 
fit_lme_safe <- function(fixed_formula, data, site_col, date_col) {
  do.call(nlme::lme, list(
    fixed       = fixed_formula,
    random      = as.formula(paste0("~ 1 | ", site_col)),
    correlation = make_cor_ar1(data, date_col = date_col, site_col = site_col),
    data        = data,
    method      = "REML",
    na.action   = na.omit,
    control     = nlme::lmeControl(msMaxIter = 200, msMaxEval = 400)
  ))
}

# safe VIF (long) utility used later to build the VIF log
safe_vif_long <- function(df, response, preds) {
  preds <- unique(preds)
  preds <- preds[!is.na(preds)]
  preds <- preds[preds %in% names(df)]
  if (length(preds) == 0L) {
    return(tibble::tibble(predictor = character(0), vif = numeric(0)))
  }
  fm <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", paste(preds, collapse = "+")))
  v <- try(suppressWarnings(car::vif(stats::lm(fm, data = df))), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(v, "try-error")) {
    return(tibble::tibble(predictor = preds, vif = NA_real_))
  }
  if (is.matrix(v)) v <- diag(v) # handle GVIF matrix case
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  v[is.na(v)] <- 1.0             # single-predictor fallback
  tibble::tibble(predictor = preds, vif = v)
}

```


*LME model training fxn*
```{r}
tidy_lme_fixed <- function(fit) {
  tt <- summary(fit)$tTable
  tibble::tibble(
    term      = rownames(tt),
    estimate  = as.numeric(tt[, "Value"]),
    std.error = as.numeric(tt[, "Std.Error"]),
    df        = as.numeric(tt[, "DF"]),
    statistic = as.numeric(tt[, "t-value"]),
    p.value   = as.numeric(tt[, "p-value"])
  )
}

train_lme_global <- function(data,
                             response,
                             predictors,
                             k = 5,
                             site_col = "Site",
                             date_col = "Datetime",
                             vif_thresh = 5) {

  base_df <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[response]]))

  folds <- make_weekly_folds(base_df, k = k, date_col = date_col)

  oof_list <- vector("list", k)
  fold_kept_preds <- vector("list", k)
  fold_dropped_preds <- vector("list", k)
  fold_gam <- vector("list", k)

  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    val_idx <- folds$indexOut[[i]]
    trn_idx <- folds$index[[i]]

    train_df <- base_df[trn_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    val_df   <- base_df[val_idx, , drop = FALSE]

    scaled <- standardize_fold(train_df, val_df)
    train_df <- scaled$train; val_df <- scaled$test
    chosen <- select_for_set(train_df, response,
                             if ("GWT_mean" %in% predictors) "all" else "remote", k=5)
    fold_gam[[i]] <- chosen$selection %>% mutate(fold=i, .before=1)
    selected <- chosen$predictors
    # Per-fold VIF pruning (no leakage)
    train_df <- train_df %>% select(all_of(c(site_col,date_col,response,selected))) %>% drop_na()
    vp <- vif_prune(train_df, response, selected, thresh = vif_thresh)
    kept <- vp$keep

          # Build fixed formula
    if (length(kept) > 0) {
      fixed_formula <- reformulate(termlabels = kept, response = response)
    } else {
      fixed_formula <- as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1"))
    }

    # Fit via do.call() so 'fixed' is the actual formula, not a dangling symbol
    fit <- fit_lme_safe(fixed_formula, train_df, site_col, date_col)


    # Predict on validation fold.
    # Use level=1 to include site random intercepts (sites exist in train due to week blocking)
    val_x <- val_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(c(site_col, date_col, response, kept)))
    val_x <- tidyr::drop_na(val_x)  # ensure no NA for predictors used in this fold

    preds <- predict(fit, newdata = val_x, level = 1)

    oof_list[[i]] <- tibble(
      Site = val_x[[site_col]],
      Date = val_x[[date_col]],
      fold = i,
      obs  = val_x[[response]],
      pred = as.numeric(preds)
    )

    fold_kept_preds[[i]]    <- kept
    fold_dropped_preds[[i]] <- vp$dropped
  }

  # Combine OOF; compute metrics
  oof <- bind_rows(oof_list)
  mets <- compute_metrics(oof, truth_col = "obs", pred_col = "pred", site_col = "Site")

  # Fit final model on full data (with VIF pruning done on full data for reporting)
  base_df <- standardize_fold(base_df)$train
  chosen_full <- select_for_set(base_df, response,
                                 if ("GWT_mean" %in% predictors) "all" else "remote", k=5)
  predictors <- chosen_full$predictors
  base_df <- base_df %>% select(all_of(c(site_col,date_col,response,predictors))) %>% drop_na()
  vp_full <- vif_prune(base_df, response, predictors, vif_thresh)
  kept_full    <- if (length(vp_full$keep) > 0) vp_full$keep else character(0)
  dropped_full <- vp_full$dropped

  if (length(kept_full) > 0) {
    fixed_formula_full <- reformulate(termlabels = kept_full, response = response)
  } else {
    fixed_formula_full <- as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1"))
  }

  fit_full <- fit_lme_safe(fixed_formula_full, base_df, site_col, date_col)

  # Extract fixed effects table
  coefs <- tidy_lme_fixed(fit_full)

  # AR(1) parameter (phi)
  phi <- tryCatch(
    as.numeric(coef(fit_full$modelStruct$corStruct, unconstrained = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  list(
    response          = response,
    model_type        = "lme",
    predictors_init   = predictors,
    vif_thresh        = vif_thresh,
    fold_kept         = fold_kept_preds,
    fold_selection    = bind_rows(fold_gam),
    selection_full    = chosen_full$selection,
    fold_dropped      = fold_dropped_preds,
    kept_full         = kept_full,
    dropped_full      = dropped_full,
    metrics_overall   = mets$overall,
    metrics_by_site   = mets$by_site,
    oof_predictions   = oof,
    fit_object        = fit_full,
    fixed_effects     = coefs,
    ar1_phi           = phi
  )
}
```


*model running fxn for each set*
```{r}
run_all_lme <- function(k = 5, vif_thresh = 5) {
  results <- list()
  for (resp_key in c("max","mean","range")) {
    df <- switch(resp_key, max = max_df, mean = mean_df, range = range_df)

    # Set A: All predictors (5 sites)
    A <- prep_dataset(df, resp_key, mode = "all")
    results[[paste(resp_key, "A_lme", sep = "_")]] <- train_lme_global(
      data = A$data, response = A$response, predictors = A$predictors,
      k = k, vif_thresh = vif_thresh
    )

    # Set B: Remote-only (7 sites)
    B <- prep_dataset(df, resp_key, mode = "remote")
    results[[paste(resp_key, "B_lme", sep = "_")]] <- train_lme_global(
      data = B$data, response = B$response, predictors = B$predictors,
      k = k, vif_thresh = vif_thresh
    )
  }
  results
}
```

*VIF table*
```{r}
# helper: for each var in x, find the var in y most correlated with it 
most_corr_partner <- function(df, x_vars, y_vars, method = "pearson") {
  x_vars <- intersect(x_vars, names(df))
  y_vars <- intersect(y_vars, names(df))
  if (length(x_vars) == 0 || length(y_vars) == 0) {
    return(tibble(predictor = character(), partner = character(), r = numeric()))
  }
  cors <- suppressWarnings(cor(df[, x_vars, drop = FALSE],
                               df[, y_vars, drop = FALSE],
                               use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
                               method = method))
  if (!is.matrix(cors)) cors <- as.matrix(cors)
  if (length(x_vars) == 1 && length(y_vars) > 1) cors <- t(cors)

  purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(x_vars), function(i) {
    rvec <- cors[i, ]
    if (length(rvec) == 0 || all(is.na(rvec))) {
      tibble(predictor = x_vars[i], partner = NA_character_, r = NA_real_)
    } else {
      j <- which.max(abs(rvec))
      tibble(predictor = x_vars[i], partner = names(rvec)[j], r = unname(rvec[j]))
    }
  })
}

# Build ONE long VIF log file (before/after + dropped) 
vif_log_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(results_lme, function(res, model_id) {
  parts <- strsplit(model_id, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  response <- parts[1]
  set_key  <- parts[2]
  alg      <- "lme"

  # Recreate dataset
  df_src <- switch(response, max = max_df, mean = mean_df, range = range_df)
  ps <- prep_dataset(df_src, response, mode = ifelse(set_key == "A", "all", "remote"))
  full_df <- standardize_fold(ps$data)$train

full_df <- full_df %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(
    c("Site", "Datetime", res$response, res$predictors_init)
  )) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

  # VIFs as before
  vif_before <- safe_vif_long(full_df, res$response, res$predictors_init) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(stage = "before")
  vif_after <- safe_vif_long(full_df, res$response, res$kept_full) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(stage = "after")
  dropped_info <- vif_before %>%
    dplyr::filter(predictor %in% res$dropped_full) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(stage = "dropped")

  # Add correlation partners for dropped vars
  corr_partners <- most_corr_partner(full_df, res$dropped_full, res$kept_full, method = "pearson")

  dropped_info <- dropped_info %>%
    dplyr::left_join(corr_partners, by = "predictor") %>%
    # Ensure columns exist even if the join added none
    { if (!"partner" %in% names(.)) dplyr::mutate(., partner = NA_character_) else . } %>%
    { if (!"r" %in% names(.)) dplyr::mutate(., r = NA_real_) else . } %>%
    dplyr::rename(partner_most_corr = partner, r_with_partner = r)

  dplyr::bind_rows(vif_before, vif_after, dropped_info) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      response = response,
      set      = set_key,
      alg      = alg,
      dropped  = stage == "dropped"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(response, set, alg, stage, predictor, vif,
                  partner_most_corr, r_with_partner, dropped)
})
```

```{r}
library(iml)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)

# Paths defined earlier in the script:
# glob_rds_path -> results_refined_revised.rds
# lme_rds_path  -> results_lme_revised.rds
# output_dir   -> results folder

# Load saved final models

stopifnot(
  length(results_refined) == 12,
  length(results_lme) == 6
)

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Allow larger model objects during permutation importance
options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)

# Same iml permutation-importance method as before
compute_perm_tbl <- function(object, train_x, train_y, pred_fun, nsim = 20) {

  pred <- iml::Predictor$new(
    model = object,
    data = train_x,
    y = train_y,
    predict.function = function(m, newdata) pred_fun(m, newdata)
  )

  fi <- iml::FeatureImp$new(
    pred,
    loss = "rmse",
    compare = "difference",
    n.repetitions = nsim
  )

  out <- as.data.frame(fi$results)

  tibble::tibble(
    Variable = out$feature,
    Importance = out$importance,
    Stderr = NA_real_
  )
}

# Prediction wrappers
pred_wrap_caret <- function(object, newdata) {
  predict(object, newdata = newdata)
}

pred_wrap_lme <- function(object, newdata) {
  predict(object, newdata = newdata, level = 0)
}

# Reconstruct the data used for each final fitted model
get_train_frame <- function(model_id) {

  parts <- strsplit(model_id, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  response_key <- parts[1]
  set_key <- parts[2]
  alg <- parts[3]

  # Original dataset for each response
  df_src <- switch(
    response_key,
    max = max_df,
    mean = mean_df,
    range = range_df
  )

  # Set A: all predictors, five sites
  # Set B: remote-only predictors, seven sites
  ps <- prep_dataset(
    df_src,
    response_key,
    mode = if (set_key == "A") "all" else "remote"
  )

  # Use predictors retained in the saved final models
  predictors <- if (alg == "lme") {
    results_lme[[model_id]]$kept_full
  } else {
    results_refined[[model_id]]$predictors
  }

  # Match full-data preprocessing from model training
  df <- ps$data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[ps$response]]))

  df <- standardize_fold(df)$train

  if (alg == "lme") {

    # LME fitting originally removed incomplete observations
    # across all initially selected predictors, before VIF pruning
    initial <- results_lme[[model_id]]$predictors_init

    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(
          c("Site", "Datetime", ps$response, initial)
        )
      ) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na()

  } else {

    # RFR and XGB fitting used complete observations
    # across their final selected predictors
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(
          c("Site", "Datetime", ps$response, predictors)
        )
      ) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na()
  }

  list(
    df = df,
    response = ps$response,
    predictors = predictors
  )
}
```

*Calculate, combine, and export*
```{r}
# Calculate, combine, and export

options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)
set.seed(42)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Permutation importance: RFR and XGB
# ---------------------------------------------------------

perm_vi_ml <- purrr::imap_dfr(results_refined, function(res, model_id) {

  td <- get_train_frame(model_id)

  train_x <- td$df %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(td$predictors))

  train_y <- td$df[[td$response]]

  vi <- compute_perm_tbl(
    object = res$fit_object,
    train_x = train_x,
    train_y = train_y,
    pred_fun = pred_wrap_caret,
    nsim = 20
  )

  parts <- strsplit(model_id, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  tibble::tibble(
    response = parts[1],
    set = parts[2],
    alg = parts[3],
    Variable = vi$Variable,
    Importance = vi$Importance,
    Stderr = vi$Stderr,
    type = "permutation"
  )
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Permutation importance: LME
# ---------------------------------------------------------

perm_vi_lme <- purrr::imap_dfr(results_lme, function(res, model_id) {

  td <- get_train_frame(model_id)

  kept <- td$predictors

  if (length(kept) == 0L) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      response = character(),
      set = character(),
      alg = character(),
      Variable = character(),
      Importance = numeric(),
      Stderr = numeric(),
      type = character()
    ))
  }

  train_x <- td$df %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(kept))

  train_y <- td$df[[td$response]]

  vi <- compute_perm_tbl(
    object = res$fit_object,
    train_x = train_x,
    train_y = train_y,
    pred_fun = pred_wrap_lme,
    nsim = 20
  )

  parts <- strsplit(model_id, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  tibble::tibble(
    response = parts[1],
    set = parts[2],
    alg = "lme",
    Variable = vi$Variable,
    Importance = vi$Importance,
    Stderr = vi$Stderr,
    type = "permutation"
  )
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Internal importance: RFR and XGB
# ---------------------------------------------------------

internal_vi_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(results_refined, function(res, model_id) {

  parts <- strsplit(model_id, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  res$var_importance %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      response = parts[1],
      set = parts[2],
      alg = parts[3],
      Variable,
      Importance = Overall,
      Stderr = NA_real_,
      type = "internal"
    )
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Combine results
# ---------------------------------------------------------

varimp_perm_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  perm_vi_ml,
  perm_vi_lme
)

varimp_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  internal_vi_all,
  varimp_perm_all
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export new files
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Collect out-of-fold predictions for Set A
# ------------------------------------------------------------

collect_oof_setA <- function(results_refined, results_lme) {

  collect_models <- function(results) {

    purrr::imap_dfr(results, function(x, nm) {

      parts <- strsplit(nm, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

      if (length(parts) != 3L || parts[2] != "A") {
        return(NULL)
      }

      oof <- x$oof_predictions

      if (is.null(oof)) {
        stop("Missing OOF predictions for model: ", nm)
      }

      tibble::tibble(
        response = parts[1],
        set      = parts[2],
        alg      = parts[3],
        Site     = oof$Site,
        Date     = oof$Date,
        obs      = oof$obs,
        pred     = oof$pred
      )
    })
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    collect_models(results_refined),
    collect_models(results_lme)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      response = factor(
        response,
        levels = c("max", "mean", "range"),
        labels = unname(resp_lab)
      ),
      alg = factor(
        alg,
        levels = c("lme", "rfr", "xgb"),
        labels = unname(alg_lab)
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(response, alg, Site, Date)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Integer axis breaks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

int_breaks <- function(lims, target = 6L) {

  lo <- floor(lims[1])
  hi <- ceiling(lims[2])

  span <- hi - lo
  step <- max(1L, round(span / target))

  seq(lo, hi, by = step)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create individual response panels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_panel <- function(dat, resp_label, show_strips = TRUE) {

  # Explicit filtering to avoid column evaluation conflicts
  dd <- dat[
    !is.na(dat$response) &
      as.character(dat$response) == resp_label,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(dd) == 0L) {
    stop("No predictions found for response: ", resp_label)
  }

  # Shared observed/predicted limits for this response
  lims_raw <- range(c(dd$obs, dd$pred), na.rm = TRUE)

  pad <- diff(lims_raw) * 0.04

  lims <- c(
    lims_raw[1] - pad,
    lims_raw[2] + pad
  )

  brk <- int_breaks(lims, target = 6L)

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = obs, y = pred)) +

    # Site-specific observations
    geom_point(
      aes(color = Site, shape = Site),
      alpha = 0.8,
      size = 2.0,
      stroke = 0.25
    ) +

    # 1:1 reference line in every facet
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "#555555",
      linewidth = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +

    # Fitted regression line
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      formula = y ~ x,
      se = FALSE,
      color = "#222222",
      linetype = "solid",
      linewidth = 1.0
    ) +

    # One row per algorithm
    ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = ggplot2::vars(alg)) +

    # Equal scaling on both axes
    coord_equal(ratio = 1) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = range(brk),
      breaks = brk,
      minor_breaks = NULL,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = range(brk),
      breaks = brk,
      minor_breaks = NULL,
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = site_cols,
      name = "Site"
    ) +

    scale_shape_manual(
      values = site_shapes,
      name = "Site"
    ) +

    labs(
      x = "Observed (°C)",
      y = "Predicted (°C)"
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.35),

      strip.text.y = if (show_strips) {
        element_text(face = "bold")
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },

      strip.background = if (show_strips) {
        element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA)
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },

      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(6, "pt"),
      plot.margin = grid::unit(c(3, 4, 3, 4), "pt")
    )

  return(p)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Build the three response columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_max <- make_panel(
  oof_A, "Max WT", show_strips = FALSE
)

p_mean <- make_panel(
  oof_A, "Mean WT", show_strips = FALSE
)

p_range <- make_panel(
  oof_A, "Range WT", show_strips = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Column headers
# ------------------------------------------------------------

hdr <- function(txt) {

  ggplot() +
    theme_void() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.5,
      y = 0.5,
      label = txt,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5
    )
}

col1 <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  hdr("Max WT"),
  p_max,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(0.06, 1)
)

col2 <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  hdr("Mean WT"),
  p_mean,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(0.06, 1)
)

col3 <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  hdr("Range WT"),
  p_range,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(0.06, 1)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Combine all nine panels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

combined <- (col1 | col2 | col3) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(
    guides = "collect",
    widths = c(1, 1, 1)
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(6, "pt"),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "pt")
  )

# Display
print(combined)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Export revised figure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fig_dir <- "C:/Users/mbkro/OneDrive/Documents/wetland-ml-models/figures"

dir.create(
  fig_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    fig_dir,
    "obs_vs_pred_global_setA_revised.png"
  ),
  plot = combined,
  width = 14,
  height = 8.8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```
